Hi Alex — thanks for flagging this. Good catch.

Short version: the US switched to DST on Sun, Mar 8 this year; the EU/UK switch is later in March (Mar 29). That two-week gap is exactly what causes the calendar mismatch.

Detail: the invite was created as "10:00 AM Eastern (ET)" — before Mar 8 ET was UTC-5, after Mar 8 ET is UTC-4. That means 10:00 AM ET now maps to 14:00 UTC / 14:00 GMT for UK attendees (not 15:00). If some of your team still has an older timezone mapping cached, they might see 15:00.

Options to avoid confusion:
- Option A — keep the time at 10:00 AM ET (14:00 UK): update invite and ask UK folks to join at 14:00 GMT.
- Option B — move the demo to 11:00 AM ET so it stays at 15:00 UK local time (easier for InfoZen if your team prefers a later afternoon slot).
- Option C — pick a UTC-fixed time (e.g., 15:00Z) and I resend invites set explicitly in UTC for clarity.

I've attached a short timezone matrix (timezone-matrix.png) and an updated agenda (demo-agenda-v2.pdf). If you want, I can send an updated .ics with the chosen option.

Quick ask for Rishi: can you confirm capacity for Mon Mar 15 at 11:00 AM ET (if Alex prefers Option B)?

—Marissa
